content: MDN Element.requestFullscreen: requires transient user activation; returns Promise, rejects (TypeError) + fullscreenerror on failure; Permissions-Policy fullscreen default allowlist self (same-origin OK). Fullscreen the container div, not the PDF itself. caniuse: Safari iOS Fullscreen API only Partial (12-26.5, never full) - video-centric; fallback open-in-tab (one explicit click) is the documented pattern when API missing.
